pages.text: Two items you will carry all the time. The $(bold)Wrench$() changes blocks. The $(bold)Engineer's Goggles$() show information about them.

pages.title: Wrench
pages.text: Right-click to rotate a component around the face you click. Sneak and right-click to dismantle it. It also moves assembled minecart and train contraptions.

pages.title: Engineer's Goggles
pages.text: Show stress impact, capacity and speed of kinetic parts, and the contents of tanks and basins, when you look at them.
Wrenches also toggle connections on encased shafts and cogwheels, and open or close the window on fluid tanks.

$(bold)Value boxes.$() Many machines show a small panel on a face. Look at it and right-click to change it, or scroll with the mouse wheel to adjust the value. Speed controllers, windmills and gearshifts use these.

$(bold)Tooltips.$() Hold Shift on any Create item for a summary of what it does and what it needs. Hold W for Ponder.$(br2)Read about stress in $(l:create_basics/stress)Stress$(/l) and see $(l:start_here/tools)Tools$(/l).
